newsitem.title: USA: Becton Dickinson to acquire PharMingen.
newsitem.headline: Becton Dickinson to acquire PharMingen.

text.p: Becton Dickinson and Co said Thursday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire PharMingen, a manufacturer of products for biomedical research.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed, but Becton Dickinson said it expects to complete the acquisition for cash, following receipt of various approvals and clearances.

PharMingen develops, manufactures and sells antibodies and reagents for immunology, cell biology, and molecular biology research. The company of 260 employees, is based in San Diego, and expects sales of about $30 million in its fiscal year ending June 30.
